Provenance & integrity
Published Webb and Hubble previews are embedded in this HTML. Loading optional GGUF enables verified tile hashes and full-resolution Hubble science pixels.

GGUF is used as a numerical tensor container, not a trained language model. Spatial zoom does not add measured resolution. The S1 candidate remains unconfirmed. The Hubble source is Proxima, a separate member of the Alpha Centauri triple system.
